entities.title: Production
entities.summary: The shatterbelt Worker at icelander.net/games/retro/shatterbelt* and icelander.net/retro-games/shatterbelt*, with its static game and the D1 database shatterbelt-scores.
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/retro/shatterbelt/ and its public scores page.
entities.deployedBy: The owner, from their own machine: `npm run deploy` in games/shatterbelt, with a Cloudflare token for the icelander.net account (or wrangler logged in to it). Nothing deploys from GitHub's runners: the Deploy workflow was removed (the owner's decision, 2026-11-21).
approvals: The owner's decision: nothing deploys on its own, and only the owner runs the deploy.
A pull request, tested by CI, for anything that reaches main: main accepts nothing else.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded: check out an earlier commit and run npm run deploy again, or roll back the Worker's version in Cloudflare. A database migration is not undone by this; migrations are written so the previous code keeps working (docs/database-migrations.md).
entities.details: The Worker's routes run ahead of the games hub's less specific icelander.net/games/*. workers_dev and preview URLs are off. Its migrations delete the Durable Object class Room, which held online rooms before they moved to the games hub; both migration entries stay, because Cloudflare applies them in order. The database was first created from worker/schema.sql by hand.
